name: Wiz
title: wiz.io
shortDescription: Wiz is a comprehensive cloud security platform designed to enhance protection across multiple cloud environments. It's tailored for security, dev, and devops teams, promoting a unified approach to cloud security. By integrating seamlessly with existing cloud infrastructures, Wiz offers agentless visibility, risk prioritization, and runtime protection. Ideal for large enterprises, such as those in the Fortune 100, Wiz helps in managing security posture and responding to threats efficiently.
pros: Trusted by over 50% of Fortune 100 companies
cons: May be complex to integrate for smaller teams
Could be overkill for non-cloud environments
Potentially high cost for small businesses
